subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible session-level command that can switch the current conversation to another configured agent without changing global bindings?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting the feature defines a security boundary for who may redirect a channel conversation into another agent's workspace, tools, credentials, and transcript store.

options.title: Design a gated core command
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, persisted session state, audit/recovery, static-default routing, and switched-routing tests.

options.title: Keep bindings static
options.body: Decline runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus Gateway restart or approved reload as the only supported cross-agent routing model.

options.title: Expose a seam first
options.body: Require a generic channel/session-routing extension point before any concrete `/agent` command ships.

recommendation.title: Design a gated core command
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, persisted session state, audit/recovery, static-default routing, and switched-routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available history owner for multi-agent routing and route resolver behavior.
